detail.unitSource:
[Unit]
Description=KubeClaw native worker role pools
Before=k3s.service k3s-agent.service
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
Slice=kubeclaw.slice
Delegate=cpu memory pids
DelegateSubgroup=setup
ExecStart=/usr/bin/env node /opt/kubeclaw/native/prepare-native-worker-pools.mjs /etc/kubeclaw/native-node-policy.json --serve
NoNewPrivileges=yes
UMask=0077
TasksMax=infinity
KillMode=control-group
TimeoutStartSec=60

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
